farm_steps: Split a small farming budget into a fresh wallet that holds only farming funds, and keep the seed phrase offline. Signal: breadth (one clean wallet is easier to prove as a farmer than a hot one). Cost: $3 of gas for the first move. Time: 10 minutes.

Deposit $150 into one of Steakhouse Financial's flagship vaults on Base and hold the shares; top up the same vault rather than splitting, so one position keeps the full record. Signal: duration (vault AUM held is what a curator launch prices). Cost: $150 allocated + vault fees in the share price. Time: 15 minutes to set up.

Once a week, do one new action the protocol counts — a top-up, a borrow, a swap or a claim of its rewards — so no snapshot window sees a static position. Signal: duration (vault AUM held is what a curator launch prices). Cost: about $2–3 of gas. Time: 10 minutes a week.

Hold the position for at least 30 days: airdrop points programs snapshot on a cadence, and one qualifying window is rarely the counted one. Signal: duration. Cost: the $150 stays allocated; opportunity cost only. Time: 30 days.

Watch the protocol's own channels for a points page, a reward switch or an announcement; record the date and URL of every change. Signal: breadth (claims are paid to the positions the program names). Cost: nothing but attention. Time: 5–10 minutes a week.

Before withdrawing anything, confirm the claim path: official page or verified handle only, and never pay a fee, a "gas helper" or a third party to claim. Signal: duration (the claim is the event the whole position exists for). Cost: a wrong click costs the position; checking costs nothing. Time: 10 minutes.

Keep a farm log: wallet address, chain, every transaction hash, its date and the protocol's TVL that day, so the position is repeatable and auditable after the launch. Signal: breadth. Cost: the log itself, nothing else. Time: 5 minutes.

farm_steps: Split a small farming budget into a fresh wallet that holds only farming funds, and keep the seed phrase offline. Signal: breadth (one clean wallet is easier to prove as a farmer than a hot one). Cost: $3 of gas for the first move. Time: 10 minutes.

Deposit $100 into one of RockawayX's flagship vaults on Ethereum and hold the shares; top up the same vault rather than splitting, so one position keeps the full record. Signal: duration (vault AUM held is what a curator launch prices). Cost: $100 allocated + vault fees in the share price. Time: 15 minutes to set up.

Once a week, do one new action the protocol counts — a top-up, a borrow, a swap or a claim of its rewards — so no snapshot window sees a static position. Signal: duration (vault AUM held is what a curator launch prices). Cost: about $2–3 of gas. Time: 10 minutes a week.

Hold the position for at least 45 days: airdrop points programs snapshot on a cadence, and one qualifying window is rarely the counted one. Signal: duration. Cost: the $100 stays allocated; opportunity cost only. Time: 45 days.

Watch the protocol's own channels for a points page, a reward switch or an announcement; record the date and URL of every change. Signal: breadth (claims are paid to the positions the program names). Cost: nothing but attention. Time: 5–10 minutes a week.

Before withdrawing anything, confirm the claim path: official page or verified handle only, and never pay a fee, a "gas helper" or a third party to claim. Signal: duration (the claim is the event the whole position exists for). Cost: a wrong click costs the position; checking costs nothing. Time: 10 minutes.

Keep a farm log: wallet address, chain, every transaction hash, its date and the protocol's TVL that day, so the position is repeatable and auditable after the launch. Signal: breadth. Cost: the log itself, nothing else. Time: 5 minutes.

farm_steps: Split a small farming budget into a fresh wallet that holds only farming funds, and keep the seed phrase offline. Signal: breadth (one clean wallet is easier to prove as a farmer than a hot one). Cost: $3 of gas for the first move. Time: 10 minutes.

Deposit $100 into one of Upshift's flagship vaults on Ethereum and hold the shares; top up the same vault rather than splitting, so one position keeps the full record. Signal: duration (vault AUM held is what a curator launch prices). Cost: $100 allocated + vault fees in the share price. Time: 15 minutes to set up.

Once a week, do one new action the protocol counts — a top-up, a borrow, a swap or a claim of its rewards — so no snapshot window sees a static position. Signal: duration (vault AUM held is what a curator launch prices). Cost: about $2–3 of gas. Time: 10 minutes a week.

Hold the position for at least 30 days: airdrop points programs snapshot on a cadence, and one qualifying window is rarely the counted one. Signal: duration. Cost: the $100 stays allocated; opportunity cost only. Time: 30 days.

Watch the protocol's own channels for a points page, a reward switch or an announcement; record the date and URL of every change. Signal: breadth (claims are paid to the positions the program names). Cost: nothing but attention. Time: 5–10 minutes a week.

Before withdrawing anything, confirm the claim path: official page or verified handle only, and never pay a fee, a "gas helper" or a third party to claim. Signal: duration (the claim is the event the whole position exists for). Cost: a wrong click costs the position; checking costs nothing. Time: 10 minutes.

Keep a farm log: wallet address, chain, every transaction hash, its date and the protocol's TVL that day, so the position is repeatable and auditable after the launch. Signal: breadth. Cost: the log itself, nothing else. Time: 5 minutes.

model.base_source: 9 trading peers in RWA (median 0.2748x TVL after clipping at the market's 90th percentile), blended toward the cross-category median (0.2138x, 128 protocols) at 5 peers of prior

farm_steps: Split a small farming budget into a fresh wallet that holds only farming funds, and keep the seed phrase offline. Signal: breadth (one clean wallet is easier to prove as a farmer than a hot one). Cost: $3 of gas for the first move. Time: 10 minutes.

Mint or buy $100 of Plume Vaults's yield-bearing asset on Ethereum and hold it to the next coupon; selling early ends the accrual. Signal: duration (RWA yields accrue on holding, not trading). Cost: $100 of principal at market entry price. Time: 15 minutes to set up.

Once a week, do one new action the protocol counts — a top-up, a borrow, a swap or a claim of its rewards — so no snapshot window sees a static position. Signal: duration (RWA yields accrue on holding, not trading). Cost: about $2–3 of gas. Time: 10 minutes a week.

Hold the position for at least 30 days: airdrop points programs snapshot on a cadence, and one qualifying window is rarely the counted one. Signal: duration. Cost: the $100 stays allocated; opportunity cost only. Time: 30 days.

Watch the protocol's own channels for a points page, a reward switch or an announcement; record the date and URL of every change. Signal: breadth (claims are paid to the positions the program names). Cost: nothing but attention. Time: 5–10 minutes a week.

Before withdrawing anything, confirm the claim path: official page or verified handle only, and never pay a fee, a "gas helper" or a third party to claim. Signal: duration (the claim is the event the whole position exists for). Cost: a wrong click costs the position; checking costs nothing. Time: 10 minutes.

Keep a farm log: wallet address, chain, every transaction hash, its date and the protocol's TVL that day, so the position is repeatable and auditable after the launch. Signal: breadth. Cost: the log itself, nothing else. Time: 5 minutes.

Deposit $75 into one of Gami Labs's flagship vaults on Stellar and hold the shares; top up the same vault rather than splitting, so one position keeps the full record. Hold the position for at least 60 days: airdrop points programs snapshot on a cadence, and one qualifying window is rarely the counted one. Signal: duration. Cost: the $75 stays allocated; opportunity cost only. Time: 60 days.

Before withdrawing anything, confirm the claim path: official page or verified handle only, and never pay a fee, a "gas helper" or a third party to claim. Signal: duration (the claim is the event the whole position exists for). Cost: a wrong click costs the position; checking costs nothing. Time: 10 minutes.

Keep a farm log: wallet address, chain, every transaction hash, its date and the protocol's TVL that day, so the position is repeatable and auditable after the launch. Signal: breadth. Cost: the log itself, nothing else. Time: 5 minutes.

Hold the position for at least 30 days: airdrop points programs snapshot on a cadence, and one qualifying window is rarely the counted one. Signal: duration. Cost: the $100 stays allocated; opportunity cost only. Time: 30 days.

Signal: duration (the claim is the event the whole position exists for). Cost: a wrong click costs the position; checking costs nothing. Time: 10 minutes.

Keep a farm log: wallet address, chain, every transaction hash, its date and the protocol's TVL that day, so the position is repeatable and auditable after the launch. Signal: breadth. Cost: the log itself, nothing else. Time: 5 minutes.

farm_steps: Split a small farming budget into a fresh wallet that holds only farming funds, and keep the seed phrase offline. Signal: breadth (one clean wallet is easier to prove as a farmer than a hot one). Cost: $2 of gas for the first move. Time: 10 minutes.

Keep $50 as margin on Reya Perps on Reya Network and open one small position that is long funding; let the position ride so volume and duration both accrue. Signal: volume (traded notional is the derivative metric). Cost: $50 margin + funding paid when you are on the wrong side. Time: 20 minutes to set up.

Once a week, do one new action the protocol counts — a top-up, a borrow, a swap or a claim of its rewards — so no snapshot window sees a static position. Signal: volume (traded notional is the derivative metric). Cost: about $2–3 of gas. Time: 10 minutes a week.

Hold the position for at least 30 days: airdrop points programs snapshot on a cadence, and one qualifying window is rarely the counted one. Signal: duration. Cost: the $50 stays allocated; opportunity cost only. Time: 30 days.

Watch the protocol's own channels for a points page, a reward switch or an announcement; record the date and URL of every change. Signal: breadth (claims are paid to the positions the program names). Cost: nothing but attention. Time: 5–10 minutes a week.

Before withdrawing anything, confirm the claim path: official page or verified handle only, and never pay a fee, a "gas helper" or a third party to claim. Signal: duration (the claim is the event the whole position exists for). Cost: a wrong click costs the position; checking costs nothing. Time: 10 minutes.

Keep a farm log: wallet address, chain, every transaction hash, its date and the protocol's TVL that day, so the position is repeatable and auditable after the launch. Signal: breadth. Cost: the log itself, nothing else. Time: 5 minutes.

farm_steps: Split a small farming budget into a fresh wallet that holds only farming funds, and keep the seed phrase offline. Signal: breadth (one clean wallet is easier to prove as a farmer than a hot one). Cost: $2 of gas for the first move. Time: 10 minutes.

Keep $75 of stablecoins deposited on Current on Sui; if its incentives name utilization, borrow against the deposit at a low rate so both sides of the book count. Signal: volume (deposits and borrows both print volume). Cost: $75 allocated; borrow fees priced before each cycle. Time: 15 minutes to set up.

Once a week, do one new action the protocol counts — a top-up, a borrow, a swap or a claim of its rewards — so no snapshot window sees a static position. Signal: volume (deposits and borrows both print volume). Cost: about $2–3 of gas. Time: 10 minutes a week.

Hold the position for at least 45 days: airdrop points programs snapshot on a cadence, and one qualifying window is rarely the counted one. Signal: duration. Cost: the $75 stays allocated; opportunity cost only. Time: 45 days.

Watch the protocol's own channels for a points page, a reward switch or an announcement; record the date and URL of every change. Signal: breadth (claims are paid to the positions the program names). Cost: nothing but attention. Time: 5–10 minutes a week.

Before withdrawing anything, confirm the claim path: official page or verified handle only, and never pay a fee, a "gas helper" or a third party to claim. Signal: duration (the claim is the event the whole position exists for). Cost: a wrong click costs the position; checking costs nothing. Time: 10 minutes.

Keep a farm log: wallet address, chain, every transaction hash, its date and the protocol's TVL that day, so the position is repeatable and auditable after the launch. Signal: breadth. Cost: the log itself, nothing else. Time: 5 minutes.

farm_steps: Split a small farming budget into a fresh wallet that holds only farming funds, and keep the seed phrase offline. Signal: breadth (one clean wallet is easier to prove as a farmer than a hot one). Cost: $2 of gas for the first move. Time: 10 minutes.

Mint or buy $75 of Anemoy Capital's yield-bearing asset on Ethereum and hold it to the next coupon; selling early ends the accrual. Signal: duration (RWA yields accrue on holding, not trading). Cost: $75 of principal at market entry price. Time: 15 minutes to set up.

Once a week, do one new action the protocol counts — a top-up, a borrow, a swap or a claim of its rewards — so no snapshot window sees a static position. Signal: duration (RWA yields accrue on holding, not trading). Cost: about $2–3 of gas. Time: 10 minutes a week.

Hold the position for at least 30 days: airdrop points programs snapshot on a cadence, and one qualifying window is rarely the counted one. Signal: duration. Cost: the $75 stays allocated; opportunity cost only. Time: 30 days.

Watch the protocol's own channels for a points page, a reward switch or an announcement; record the date and URL of every change. Signal: breadth (claims are paid to the positions the program names). Cost: nothing but attention. Time: 5–10 minutes a week.

Before withdrawing anything, confirm the claim path: official page or verified handle only, and never pay a fee, a "gas helper" or a third party to claim. Signal: duration (the claim is the event the whole position exists for). Cost: a wrong click costs the position; checking costs nothing. Time: 10 minutes.

Keep a farm log: wallet address, chain, every transaction hash, its date and the protocol's TVL that day, so the position is repeatable and auditable after the launch. Signal: breadth. Cost: the log itself, nothing else. Time: 5 minutes.

Keep a farm log: wallet address, chain, every transaction hash, its date and the protocol's TVL that day, so the position is repeatable and auditable after the launch. Signal: breadth. Cost: the log itself, nothing else. Time: 5 minutes.

why_it_could_be_wrong: TVL fell 5.2% over the last 7 days; the momentum term is a haircut, not a growth credit

model.base_source: 15 trading peers in Lending (median 0.1324x TVL after clipping at the market's 90th percentile), blended toward the cross-category median (0.2138x, 128 protocols) at 5 peers of prior

farm_steps: Split a small farming budget into a fresh wallet that holds only farming funds, and keep the seed phrase offline. Signal: breadth (one clean wallet is easier to prove as a farmer than a hot one). Cost: $2 of gas for the first move. Time: 10 minutes.

Keep $75 of stablecoins deposited on Templar Lending on Stellar; if its incentives name utilization, borrow against the deposit at a low rate so both sides of the book count. Signal: volume (deposits and borrows both print volume). Cost: $75 allocated; borrow fees priced before each cycle. Time: 15 minutes to set up.

Once a week, do one new action the protocol counts — a top-up, a borrow, a swap or a claim of its rewards — so no snapshot window sees a static position. Signal: volume (deposits and borrows both print volume). Cost: about $2–3 of gas. Time: 10 minutes a week.

Hold the position for at least 30 days: airdrop points programs snapshot on a cadence, and one qualifying window is rarely the counted one. Signal: duration. Cost: the $75 stays allocated; opportunity cost only. Time: 30 days.

Watch the protocol's own channels for a points page, a reward switch or an announcement; record the date and URL of every change. Signal: breadth (claims are paid to the positions the program names). Cost: nothing but attention. Time: 5–10 minutes a week.

Before withdrawing anything, confirm the claim path: official page or verified handle only, and never pay a fee, a "gas helper" or a third party to claim. Signal: duration (the claim is the event the whole position exists for). Cost: a wrong click costs the position; checking costs nothing. Time: 10 minutes.

Keep a farm log: wallet address, chain, every transaction hash, its date and the protocol's TVL that day, so the position is repeatable and auditable after the launch. Signal: breadth. Cost: the log itself, nothing else. Time: 5 minutes.

why_it_could_be_wrong: only 1 trading peer in Risk Curators; most of the base is the cross-category median, not this category

model.base_source: 1 trading peer in Risk Curators (median 2.9555x TVL after clipping at the market's 90th percentile), blended toward the cross-category median (0.2138x, 128 protocols) at 5 peers of prior

farm_steps: Split a small farming budget into a fresh wallet that holds only farming funds, and keep the seed phrase offline. Signal: breadth (one clean wallet is easier to prove as a farmer than a hot one). Cost: $2 of gas for the first move. Time: 10 minutes.

Deposit $50 into one of alphagrowth's flagship vaults on Base and hold the shares; top up the same vault rather than splitting, so one position keeps the full record. Signal: duration (vault AUM held is what a curator launch prices). Cost: $50 allocated + vault fees in the share price. Time: 15 minutes to set up.

Once a week, do one new action the protocol counts — a top-up, a borrow, a swap or a claim of its rewards — so no snapshot window sees a static position. Signal: duration (vault AUM held is what a curator launch prices). Cost: about $2–3 of gas. Time: 10 minutes a week.

Hold the position for at least 30 days: airdrop points programs snapshot on a cadence, and one qualifying window is rarely the counted one. Signal: duration. Cost: the $50 stays allocated; opportunity cost only. Time: 30 days.

Watch the protocol's own channels for a points page, a reward switch or an announcement; record the date and URL of every change. Signal: breadth (claims are paid to the positions the program names). Cost: nothing but attention. Time: 5–10 minutes a week.

Before withdrawing anything, confirm the claim path: official page or verified handle only, and never pay a fee, a "gas helper" or a third party to claim. Signal: duration (the claim is the event the whole position exists for). Cost: a wrong click costs the position; checking costs nothing. Time: 10 minutes.

Keep a farm log: wallet address, chain, every transaction hash, its date and the protocol's TVL that day, so the position is repeatable and auditable after the launch. Signal: breadth. Cost: the log itself, nothing else. Time: 5 minutes.

steps.signal: duration (the claim is the event the whole position exists for)
steps.cost: a wrong click costs the position; checking costs nothing

steps.do: Keep a farm log: wallet address, chain, every transaction hash, its date and the protocol's TVL that day, so the position is repeatable and auditable after the launch.
steps.signal: breadth
steps.cost: the log itself, nothing else

farm_plan.risk: Risks: impermanent loss and/or depeg on one asset leg; smart-contract risk in every step.
farm_plan.skip_if: Skip if you can only hold for under two weeks: TVL is falling this week and the position needs a long window to matter.
